name: ribbonwell.account.get
description: Read the account, the member the Agent acts for and the current environment time (now). Reads and writes never move the clock; only the environment does.

name: ribbonwell.groups.list
description: List the groups this member belongs to. Group IDs come from here.

name: ribbonwell.groups.get
description: Read one group and its members. Member IDs come from here. A group this member is not in returns not_found.

name: ribbonwell.lists.list
description: List wish lists in this member's groups, optionally by group, owner or an occasion-date window. List IDs come from here. view is own, managed or other.

name: ribbonwell.lists.get
description: Read one list with its items. On the member's own list every item has claims_hidden true and no claim field; on other and managed lists each item has remaining, over_claimed and claims. Item IDs come from here.

name: ribbonwell.items.get
description: Read one item (same view rules as lists.get). Use it before reserving: remaining and claims are what a reservation is checked against.

name: ribbonwell.items.search
description: Search listed items on visible lists by text in name, variant, store or note. Own-list items never carry claim fields.

name: ribbonwell.claims.list
description: List this member's own claims (reservations and purchases for others), with the read status (reserved, lapsed, purchased, released), private note, exchange tag and any change the owner made since. Claim IDs come from here.

name: ribbonwell.exchanges.list
description: List gift exchanges in this member's groups with their current status. Exchange IDs come from here.

name: ribbonwell.exchanges.get
description: Read one exchange. After a draw only this member's own giftee is returned (my_giftee). draw_ready and draw_blockers say whether a draw would succeed.

name: ribbonwell.notifications.list
description: List in-App notifications about what other members did, oldest first. Nothing is sent outside the App.

name: ribbonwell.lists.update
description: Set or clear the occasion name and date of a list this member owns or manages (id is the list).

name: ribbonwell.items.add
description: Add an item to a list this member owns or manages (id is the list). Returns the new item ID.

name: ribbonwell.items.update
description: Change fields of a listed item on a list this member owns or manages (id is the item). On the member's own list the result never depends on claims.

name: ribbonwell.items.remove
description: Remove an item from a list this member owns or manages (id is the item). Claims on it are kept. Undo with items.restore.

name: ribbonwell.items.restore
description: Restore a removed item (id is the item).

name: ribbonwell.claims.reserve
description: Reserve a quantity of an item on someone else's list (id is the item). The hold lasts 14 days from now unless extended or marked purchased. Returns the new claim ID.

name: ribbonwell.claims.update
description: Change one of this member's claims (id is the claim): quantity, status (purchased or reserved), reserved_until (at most 14 days ahead), private note, or exchange tag.

name: ribbonwell.claims.release
description: Release one of this member's claims (id is the claim). A later reservation creates a new claim.

name: ribbonwell.exchanges.create
description: Create a gift exchange in a group this member belongs to (id is the group). The creator is the organizer and is not joined automatically. Returns the new exchange ID.

name: ribbonwell.exchanges.update
description: As organizer, change an exchange before its draw (id is the exchange).

name: ribbonwell.exchanges.join
description: Join an open exchange (id is the exchange).

name: ribbonwell.exchanges.leave
description: Leave an exchange before its draw (id is the exchange).

name: ribbonwell.exchanges.draw
description: As organizer, run the draw (id is the exchange). It cannot be undone. Returns only this member's own giftee.
